tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is much longer than the pilot window, and the candidate mechanisms predict different long-horizon behavior. A slow-horizon probe directly addresses that identifiability gap.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows do not identify the slow response reliably at the target horizon.
The pilot has zero s_grad and cannot identify its sink dependence; the slow-horizon probe is needed first.
Additional fine short-window observations would not resolve long-horizon reversal as directly.
The short pilot does not distinguish it sufficiently from adaptation at the target horizon.
